search_text: published ZDI-25-371 ZDI-CAN-25518 Trend Micro Endpoint Encryption DeserializeFromBase64String Deserialization of Untrusted Data Remote Code Execution Vulnerability 2025-06-11 CVE-2025-49212 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2025-49212 8.8 AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H ['Trend Micro'] ['Endpoint Encryption'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Trend Micro Endpoint Encryption. Although authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability, the existing authentication mechanism can be bypassed. The specific flaw exists within the implementation of the DeserializeFromBase64String method. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of user-supplied data, which can result in deserialization of untrusted data. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of SYSTEM. Trend Micro has issued an update to correct this vulnerability. title: Trend Micro Endpoint Encryption DeserializeFromBase64String Deserialization of Untrusted Data Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Trend Micro Endpoint Encryption. Although authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability, the existing authentication mechanism can be bypassed. The specific flaw exists within the implementation of the DeserializeFromBase64String method. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of user-supplied data, which can result in deserialization of untrusted data.
